name: North Haven Recreation Summer Programs
description_short: The North Haven Department of Recreation runs town summer programs, including camps, swim lessons and sports clinics, for North Haven residents. Details for each program are in the department's summer brochure.

source.title: Recreation Summer Brochure 2026 and Music Under the Stars Dates Now Available

warnings: The source is a town news post announcing the summer brochure. It is not the brochure and has no details about any specific camp.
The season shown (Summer 2026) is already over as of today (2026-10-13). No 2027 information is given.

No camp names, sessions, dates, ages or prices are given. Resident mail-in registration opened April 27 and walk-in registration May 4 (2026 season), but these dates don't belong to any specific session.
Much of the post covers the free Music Under the Stars concert series, which is not a camp.
